description: Ministry of Transportation (MOT) Highway Profile is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Construction and Maintenance. A Highway Profile defines the number of through travel lanes, including passing and truck lanes, and whether the road is divided or not. It is a Linear feature. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Construction and Maintenance. Its tags are HP, MOT, MOT asset, MOT inventory, highway profile. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
